item.title: Spotlit in Seattle: kelly langeslay
item.description: A Storyteller Who’s Reshaping Dance, One Melting Barbie Cake at a Time by Nico Swenson kelly langeslay is redefining Seattle dance. With stories spoken “to and/or about you,” they create sincere, striking pieces that are the perfect balance of writing, dance, performance art, and Shrek references.
